title: Eruption
desc: The ground begins to tremble. Billows of grey clouds fill the sky above as ash rains down. You have to get away, NOW!
eff: If there is a volcano tile, it erupts. All adjacent Resource Tiles lose 1d6 of each resource. Then, shuffle this card back into the deck.

title: Benevolence
desc: The spirits of the land are feeling generous today.
eff: Roll 1d6 to gather additional resources from this tile. If there are no Resources, place down a single Resource Tile adjacent to you and Populate it.

title: Earthquake
desc: The land beneath you cracks and groans as a massive rift divides the earth beneath.
eff: Swap the tile you're standing on with one other tile. Any Player on the tiles move with the tiles.

title: Vivacious
desc: The land is very active today.
eff: Gain a Verb Sigil.

title: Swell
desc: The magic of the world swells around you manifesting in a sigil.
eff: If you have at least 3 Crystals or you are standing on a Cave tile, gain 1 Sigil.

title: Well
desc: The water receeds from the flood plain revealing a well of magic.
eff: Gain 1 Sigil. If not on or adjacent to a Floodplains, place a Floodplains adjacent to your current tile.

title: Flood
desc: The rivers are flooding.
eff: All Plains adjacent to a body of water become Floodplains.

title: Drought
desc: Your city is experiencing a drought.
eff: All Floodplains up to 2 tiles away become Plains.

title: Growth
desc: You find glowing roots extruding, slithering out over the soil. Flowers and weeds bloom in abundance where ever the lights touch.
eff: Gain a Quantity Sigil.

title: Manifest
desc: Your patron has found their way into your deepest desires. You find the object of your desires manifested in front of you, ready for you to control.
eff: Gain a Subject Sigil.

title: Yearning
desc: You have been yearning for something just beyond your reach. Today, though, you find a new power to use it at your disposal.
eff: Gain a Subject Sigil.

title: Lost
desc: Go spelunking, they said, it'll be fun! What they never say is what happens when you get lost. If you ever find a way out, you know where to find a new marble deposit.
eff: Gain a Verb Sigil.

title: Nature
desc: The trees are alive?
eff: Gain a Subject Sigil.

title: Rock
desc: You hear a rock speaking to you. It seems to want to be friends.
eff: Gain a Subject Sigil.

title: Visions
desc: You've been seeing visions of a specific action over and over again. You feel the power to do it at your disposal.
eff: Gain a Verb Sigil.

title: Prophecy
desc: A chill runs down your spine and you find yourself locked into place. A prophetic word is hissed into your ear.
eff: Gain an Subject Sigil or Verb Sigil.

title: Destiny
desc: You've found yourself moving through the world with a particular intensity. Perhaps it could dictate your magic as well.
eff: Gain a Quantity Sigil.

title: Prize
desc: As your explore, you find a locked, decrepit chest. It seems to be vibrating with your approach. Will you open it?
eff: If you open it, gain 1 Sigil. If you don't, take 2 Resources, then reshuffle this card back into the deck.

title: Siren
desc: In a clearing, you hear a siren's call from a small pond. Roll to resist it, or use a spell to otherwise stop its call.
eff: Roll a d6. On 4+, gain a Verb Sigil.

title: Maze
desc: You find yourself at the mouth of an ever-shifting labyrinth.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Roll a d6. On 4+, conquer the maze, gain 2 sigils, and discard this card. Else, retain this card.

title: Deity
desc: You find the temple of a long-forgotten deity. There is a place for an offering.
eff: Leave 3 Crystal to gain 1 Sigil. Otherwise, discard this card.

title: Choice
desc: Your guide offers you the chance to gain two boons, or the safety to guarantee one. Choose your path.
eff: Chance: Roll a d6. On 4+, gain 1 Quantity Sigil and 1 Sigil. Otherwise, gain none. Safety: Gain 1 Sigil.

title: Curiosity
desc: You hear a scuttering in the brush nearby, a yip follows shortly after. Do you investigate or continue on your path?
eff: Investigate: You find a fox kit stuck in a bramble, with something shiny in its mouth. Gain 1 Sigil. Continue: Move to an adjacent tile and take another Narrative Event before ending your turn.

title: Breeze
desc: A wind current blows across the island, strong enough to lift your hard-earned resources.
eff: Choose another Player. You two may take a Trade for up to 6 Resources, regardless of your position

title: Masquerade
desc: You stumble upon a grove of ghosts, twirling around to music you cannot hear. They stop and stare when you arrive, expecting an offering.
eff: Give 3 Crystals to gain 2 Influence, then discard. Otherwise, discard this card.

title: Stars
desc: Magic surges from the sky, resulting in shooting stars of condensed power. If only you could catch one...
eff: Roll a d6. On 4+, gain 1 Sigil.

title: Power
desc: Two gargoyles sit at an abandoned ruins. Great power rests within them. Will you unlock it through rebirth or destruction?
eff: Rebuild: Give 2 Stone to repair them, and gain 1 Influence. Align 1 towards the Sun. Destroy: Gain 1 Sigil. Align 1 towards the Moon.

title: Shards
desc: A gnome made of porcelain with a broken hat hobbles up to your feet. It threatens you with its own shards, seeking something to fix its wounds.
eff: Pay 2 Marble to the gnomes. Otherwise, lose 3 Stone.

title: Spotted
desc: A figure lurks within the fog. It spots you, just as you have found it. It approaches, leaving you with two options: stay or hide?
eff: Stay: Pay 2 Crystal to uncover the creature in the fog. Gain 1 Sigil. Hide: Pay 1 Stone and 1 Wood to escape from the creature. Align 1 towards the Moon.

title: Chance
desc: The spirit of chance has bestowed itself upon you. It would be a waste not to utilize Lady Luck's blessing.
eff: Choose another Player and together decide on the stakes of a dice roll. Both Players roll a d6. The higher number wins and obtains the reward from the bet.

title: Masks
desc: You come across a group of masked individuals building a wooden structure. As you approach, they simply stare in your direction. Perhaps you could lend a hand?
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Donate 2 Resources or use a Spell to assist their building. If you donate, Gain 1 Influence. If you cast a Spell, draw 3 Sigils.

title: Fishing
desc: An old man walks by. He claims there's a really good fishing spot nearby, but he needs 5 wood to show you.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Upon paying: place the Fishing Boats on a Lake, and move your charater onto that same Lake. Gain 1 Influence + 3 Influence per adjacent floodplains. That Lake is traversable.

title: Admiration
desc: You find a person sitting forlornly on a rock, visibly smitten. They tell you they want you to send a letter to their secret admirer.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Return the letter to a Stone Building. Gain a Verb Sigil upon completion.

title: Scrying
desc: There's an abandoned tower in the distance. An eerie hum could be heard as you approach.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 5 Crystals to Build the Scryer's Tower. Gain a Subject Sigil upon completion.

title: Desperation
desc: A ghost happens upon you. "Crystals... I need more crystals..." Its muttering scares and intrigues you. Will you give it the crystals it seeks?
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 2 Crystals. Upon giving Resources: The ghost seems pleased, and it cackles before handing you a Subject Sigil. "Enjoy," it giggles once more before disappearing.

title: Rainbow
desc: A portal opens, folding and bending in strange ways as you venture forward hesitantly. Light scatters from it, refracting into small rainbows.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 7 Crystals to Build the Portal Circle. Place one side adjacent or under you, and the other on any buildable tile. Gain 1 Sigil upon completion.

title: Shiny
desc: In your travels, you meet a dwarf looking to build a home. He offers you shiny objects from his adventures in exchange for the materials.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 2 Stone and 2 Wood. Gain 2 Sigils upon completion.

title: Religion
desc: A zealot wishes to make a shrine of their god. They claim you will receive some of the blessings their god chooses to bestow.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 1 wood, 1 stone, and 4 crystal. Gain 1 of each Sigil upon completion.

title: Repair
desc: Half-buried in the ground, you find an old and broken porcelain doll. With some resources and TLC, you might be able to restore it to its original form.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 1 Marble and 2 Crystal. Upon giving resources: The doll clicks gratefully. It opens its jaw to reveal a glimmering gift for you before it slowly twirls away. Gain a Quantity Sigil.

title: Tutorial
desc: A fae incapable of bargaining begs for your assistance to fit in with its fairy friends. Perhaps a demonstration is in order.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Convince a Player to Trade with you. On a successful Trade, gain 1 Sigil.

title: Ouch!
desc: A woodpecker manages to peck you on the forehead instead of a nearby tree. Somehow, it believes you are to blame, and threatens to peck again.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Give this card to another Player. Collect 10 wood cumulatively. Both gain 1 Sigil upon completion. The Player who drew the card gets 2 Resources.

title: Burglary
desc: A shifty goblin has taught you the ways of pickpocketing. Now's the chance to use what you've learned.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] If someone walks adjacent to your tile, you may steal 2 Resources from them. Discard once this card has been used.

title: Worthy
desc: A messenger spirit will bless you with her speed that is, if you can prove you know what to do with it.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] As long as you hold this invitation, you have +2 Speed. Travel to 6 different tiles within 2 turns, and gain 2 Sigils. Otherwise, discard.

title: Treasure
desc: After a short conversation with a pirate, you find yourself hunting for buried treasure. You can feel it in your vicinity...somewhere...
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Roll a d6. On 4+, gain 2 Sigils and discard this Invitation. On 3-, you may try again next turn on a different tile.

title: Dam
desc: A dam breaks near a lake, causing water to rush out onto the surrounding plains. It would be wise to fix it before the flood spreads.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] All Plains adjacent to a Lake become Floodplains. Pay 4 Wood to rebuild the dam. On completion, Gain 3 Stone, 1 Sigil, and affected Floodplains return to Plains.

title: Shadow
desc: Your shadow starts to writhe unnaturally, wreaking havoc in its sudden tangibility with the area. It might be best to return it to its natural form.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 3 Crystal on a non-resource tile. Gain 1 Sigil and 1 Influence.

title: Tick-Tock
desc: A cuckoo clock ticks irregularly, making it impossible to tell the time. If you fixed it, there might be a prize awaiting at the right time.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Use 2 Marble and 2 Crystal to fix the clock. Upon completion, gain 2 sigils.

title: Knowledge
desc: Lodged within a stone is a rundown tome. With some additional resources, perhaps you could read what its pages wish to uncover.
eff: [Hanging Invitation] Pay 3 Wood to repair the book. Upon completion, it imparts its knowledge unto you; gain 1 Influence.

title: Friend
desc: A wolf pup sniffs its way to your feet. As you walk, it weaves itself between your legs. No matter what you do, you've become inseparable.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] For 2 turns, your Speed is halved. Go to a Farm to get a treat for your new pet. Upon completion: Gain a subject sigil and your Speed returns to normal if it isn't already.

title: Play
desc: A forest fairy has found its way to you and wants to play a game. It won't let you go until you win.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] Roll a d6. 1-2: You lose SO BAD. Lose 3 Resources. 3-4: It's a tie. Discard the invitation. 5-6: You....won! Gain a quantity sigil and discard the invitation.

title: Ring
desc: You step into a ring of mushrooms, but the pixies take a liking to you. Pass this Curse to another player of your choice.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] The Player who cursed you may take 1 Resource of their choice from you on their turns until completion. Pay 4 Resources while standing on a Forest tile to resolve.

title: Dinner
desc: You stumble into a witch's trap. Disappointed that you destroyed her means of catching dinner, she threatens to eat you unless you help her set another.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] The witch siphons 1 Crystal from you every turn until completion. Pay 2 wood and 1 crystal at the swamp.

title: Rot
desc: A swamp hag has unfortunately taken an interest in you. The rot of her bog sticks to your feet long after you leave.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] Your Speed is halved until completion. Visit a Lake to cleanse yourself.

title: Restoration
desc: A wandering naiad has seen the way you pillage the land. She wishes to return your resources to the sea.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] Movement on any water-based tiles or buildings costs 2 Speed. Return 1 stone and 1 marble to the ocean (any edge tile) to resolve.

title: Reconciliation
desc: Somehow, you and another player have ended up a proverbial "get-along shirt," causing your reserves to be linked.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] You may give this curse to another Player. Your inventories are now synced. If you are the recipient, cast any Spell to discard this invitation.

title: Combat
desc: You must prove that you are worthy of the magic you wield in a test of might. Choose your opponent and commence your battle!
eff: [Cursed Invitation] You and another Player of your choosing roll a d6. The lower roll is now cursed and loses influence when they build Wood-foundation buildings. Pay 2 Wood in a Forest to clear.

title: Leech
desc: You find an odd-looking leech while you traverse the land. When you gift it a host, it's more than willing to repay the favor.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] Give this curse to another Player. You additionally gain half of all Resources the recipient gains. Recipient, discard 1 of each Resource from your inventory to complete.

title: Roots
desc: The rugged roots in the ground beneath lift and wrap around your ankles. You'll have to cut yourself out before the earth swallows you whole.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] You and a Player of your choosing lose 1 Speed per turn until completion. Collect 8 stone cumulatively, or use a Spell relating to Wood.

title: Exhaustion
desc: Magic builds inside you, draining your biological reserves in the process. You'll need to expel some of that energy, the sooner the better.
eff: [Cursed Invitation] Normal terrain (1-cost) becomes difficult (2-cost), and difficult (2-cost) terrain becomes impassable. Target another Player with a Spell to resolve.

title: Vampirism
desc: A supicious-looking bat graze its fangs against you while you're unaware. The bite healed, but you have a sudden aversion to the sun...
eff: [Cursed Invitation] You cannot enter any building owned by another Player without their permission. If you are adjacent to another Player, you may pass this curse to them. Complete by discarding a Sigil.

title: Puppeteer
desc: You find a marionette shaped like another player. It calls to you to take it, an untold power brimming beneath its stitches.
eff: Target a Player. You may initiate any Trade that they must agree to. You can maximum gain 5 Resources from this Trade.
